lane: SQL + Storage + Admin: Admin redesign step A3 (D7 per-item drafts and publish, D8 content-images bucket, D10 admin timeline)
goal: Prepare, without applying, the backend and Admin screens for step A3 of spec ADMIN_SCREENS_SPEC_2026-11-04: server-side drafts per content item (persona, deck, card, app copy, asset) with per-item publish that merges only the named items into a new published bundle (AD-01/03/06), item history and restore as a new draft (AD-07), persona publish synced into public.personas so chat reads the same source (spec 3.3), a server check that editors cannot change an item's published status (AD-15), a content-images Storage bucket for image upload (D8, AD-08) and one admin timeline RPC (D10, spec 3.15). Editors only save drafts; content.publish (Owner/admin) publishes. Without the migrations the Admin keeps the current whole-bundle behaviour and names the migration it needs.
successCriteria: Migration 20261113100000 creates public.admin_content_item_versions (RLS on, no client grants) and security definer RPCs with empty search_path: list_content_item_drafts (content.read), save_content_item_draft (content.draft, optimistic revision, refuses an editor's status change), publish_content_items (content.publish, note 5-500 characters, required p_expected_revisions with the reviewed draft revision of every key and 40001 when a draft was saved after the review opened, merges only the named items into a new published admin_content_bundles version, archives the previous bundle and item versions, syncs persona items into public.personas, audit row), list_content_item_history (content.read) and restore_content_item_version (content.draft, copies an old version into the draft). anon has no execute.

Migration 20261113100100 creates get_admin_timeline(limit, before) (hub.read) returning actor, action, target, created_at and an allowlisted note from admin_audit_logs and admin_content_bundle_events; role changes only for roles.manage.

Migration 20261113100200 creates the public content-images bucket (png/jpeg/webp, 1 MB) with insert by content.draft and delete by content.delete through nilaza_private.has_capability; separate file for its own approval.

PGlite verification passes for the permission matrix owner/admin/editor/safety_reviewer/anon, per-item publish leaves other drafts untouched, restore creates a draft, persona sync, timeline rows; Storage policies are stubbed or stated not verified.

Admin content workspace: Luu nhap saves the item to the server, lists filter Dang dung / Nhap / Thieu ban dich, the 78-card list filters Thieu ban dich / Thieu anh / Sua chua phat hanh, Xem lai & phat hanh shows the diff against the published item and requires a note (content.publish only; editors see cho Owner phat hanh), history panel with Khoi phuc, image upload to content-images; when an RPC or the bucket is missing the page keeps whole-bundle behaviour and names the migration.
Lich su thao tac shows the timeline page wired to get_admin_timeline instead of the A2 pending page.

npm run admin:test (with new scripts/admin-a3-content.test.mjs), admin:check (known CRLF steps aside), validate-admin-contract, validate:data, validate:backend, supabase:check and feature-preflight --ci pass.

impact.entryPoint: Admin Noi dung pages (Nguoi dan, Bo bai, 78 la, Hinh anh, Van ban trong app) and the Lich su thao tac nav item (new timeline workspace page, hub.read).
impact.dataWrite: New table public.admin_content_item_versions (Admin-written content only); new published admin_content_bundles rows on per-item publish; upsert of public.personas canonical fields on persona publish; admin_audit_logs and admin_content_bundle_events rows; image objects in the content-images bucket.
impact.backendContract: Runtime readers keep get_published_content_bundle and public.personas; a per-item publish produces an ordinary published bundle version, so app and Edge readers see no shape change. Persona sync writes only slug, type, status, access_tier, name, short_description, transparency_note, themes, tone.
impact.adminVisibility: Per-item draft state, diff vs published, history with who and when, timeline of content/AI/role actions with actor email and note; buttons follow server capabilities (content.draft, content.publish) instead of role names.
impact.privacySafety: Content and staff actions only; no user journals, chats or birth data. Timeline returns allowlisted metadata (note, feature, version, kind, key) and staff emails only to hub.read accounts; role changes only to roles.manage. Images are public-read by design (app content) and limited to png/jpeg/webp up to 1 MB; SVG refused.
impact.observability: Every save, restore and publish writes admin_audit_logs (content.item.draft, content.item.restore, content.items.publish) and publish writes a bundle event; the new timeline page reads them.
impact.rollback: Restore an older item version and publish it, or publish an older bundle through the existing path. Dropping the new table and RPCs returns the Admin to whole-bundle behaviour automatically (fallback on PGRST202/42883/404). Bucket can be emptied and removed by the Owner.

securityReview.sensitiveData: Content copy and staff action history only. Timeline exposes staff emails and allowlisted metadata to hub.read accounts, never raw metadata.
securityReview.secretsLogging: No secret is read, set or logged; uploads use the signed-in session.
securityReview.externalInput: Kind fixed list, item key pattern, payload object with matching id and size cap, revision integer, note 5-500 characters, limit clamped 1-200; personas sync validates type, status and tier against the table checks. Upload checks type and size in the browser and the bucket enforces both again.
securityReview.migrationRelease: Owner applies each of the three migrations separately by hash on Singapore; until then the Admin falls back to the current whole-bundle path and shows which migration is missing. No Edge Function redeploy is needed.
securityReview.stopCondition: Stop if PGlite verification or admin tests fail, or if publishing one item could change another item's published content.

managerTestPath: After the Owner applies the three migrations: as editor, change a persona's description and press Luu nhap, reload: the change is still there and the list shows Nhap; the publish button says cho Owner phat hanh. As Owner, open Xem lai & phat hanh on that persona: the diff shows only that persona, enter a note, publish: the app chat uses the new description; another editor's unpublished card edit stays a draft. Open Lich su on the persona and press Khoi phuc on the previous version: a new draft appears. Upload a PNG under 1 MB to a card. Lich su thao tac lists these actions with the note.
residualRisk: PGlite is not Supabase: Storage policies are not executed (no storage schema) and need a manual upload check after the bucket migration; re-run the Security Advisor after applying (new security definer RPCs expected). Two people saving the same item: the second save with a stale revision is refused and the Admin shows a field diff of the server draft against the local edit, with “Dùng bản trên máy chủ” (drop the local edit of that item) or “Ghi đè bằng bản của tôi” (rebase onto the server revision and save); no automatic merge. A publish whose reviewed revision is stale is refused and the Admin reloads. Whole-bundle publish (fallback and seed bootstrap) still exists and would publish everything; per-item publish ignores it.
